web.title: Object Detection and Visual Grounding with Qwen 2.5
web.description:
## [How Spatial Understanding Works in Qwen 2.5 VL Models](https://pyimagesearch.com/2025/06/09/object-detection-and-visual-grounding-with-qwen-2-5/#TOC-h2-How-Spatial-Understanding-Works-in-Qwen-2-5-VL-Models)
### [Model Response Format](https://pyimagesearch.com/2025/06/09/object-detection-and-visual-grounding-with-qwen-2-5/#TOC-h3-Model-Response-Format)
#### [Bounding Box Coordinates (bbox_2d or point_2d)](https://pyimagesearch.com/2025/06/09/object-detection-and-visual-grounding-with-qwen-2-5/#TOC-h4-Bounding-Box-Coordinates-bbox-2d-or-point-2d)
- `bbox_2d`: A bounding box with four coordinates `[x1, y1, x2, y2]`, where `(x1, y1)` is the top-left corner, and `(x2, y2)` is the bottom-right corner.

## [Hands-on with Qwen 2.5 VL for Spatial Understanding](https://pyimagesearch.com/2025/06/09/object-detection-and-visual-grounding-with-qwen-2-5/#TOC-h2-Hands-on-with-Qwen-2-5-VL-for-Spatial-Understanding)
### [Setting Up Qwen 2.5 VL Model and Inference Function](https://pyimagesearch.com/2025/06/09/object-detection-and-visual-grounding-with-qwen-2-5/#TOC-h3-Setting-Up-Qwen-2-5-VL-Model-and-Inference-Function)
#### [Parsing the Response and Plotting Bounding Boxes](https://pyimagesearch.com/2025/06/09/object-detection-and-visual-grounding-with-qwen-2-5/#TOC-h4-Parsing-Response-and-Plotting-Bounding-Boxes)
```
import json
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from PIL import Image
import matplotlib.patches as patches

def plot_bounding_boxes(image, json_data, height, width):
  image = image.resize((width, height))
  # Parse the JSON input
  json_data = json_data.split('```json')[1].split('```')[0]
  bbox_data = json.loads(json_data)

  # Plot the image
  fig, ax = plt.subplots(1)
  ax.imshow(image)
  ax.axis('off')

  # Plot the bounding boxes and labels
  for item in bbox_data:
      bbox = item['bbox_2d']
      label = item['label']
      rect = patches.Rectangle((bbox[0], bbox[1]), bbox[2] - bbox[0], bbox[3] - bbox[1], linewidth=2, edgecolor='r', facecolor='none')
      ax.add_patch(rect)
      plt.text(bbox[0], bbox[1] - 10, label, color='r', fontsize=10)

  plt.show()
```

### [Testing the Setup](https://pyimagesearch.com/2025/06/09/object-detection-and-visual-grounding-with-qwen-2-5/#TOC-h3-Testing-the-Setup)
#### [Precise Visual Grounding](https://pyimagesearch.com/2025/06/09/object-detection-and-visual-grounding-with-qwen-2-5/#TOC-h4-Precise-Visual-Grounding)
```
prompt = "Detect the cupcake with choco-chips on it in the image and return its locations in the form of coordinates. "

image = Image.open(requests.get("https://th.bing.com/th/id/OIP.AfqWYODEWRwb4yP3U7p8ZwHaFX?rs=1&pid=ImgDetMain", stream=True).raw)

response, height, width = zero_shot_inference(model, processor, image, prompt)
print("Image size: ", image.size)

print(response)
plot_bounding_boxes(image, response, height, width)
```

#### [Understanding Relationships in Image](https://pyimagesearch.com/2025/06/09/object-detection-and-visual-grounding-with-qwen-2-5/#TOC-h4-Understanding-Relationships-in-Image)
```

# Cosmos Reason2 Models on Jetson
## Step 4: Serve Cosmos Reason2 with vLLM
```
cd ~/Projects/CosmosReason2/cosmos-reason2-2b_v1208-fp8-static-kv8
cp preprocessor_config.json preprocessor_config.json.bak

python3 -c "
import json
with open('preprocessor_config.json') as f:
    cfg = json.load(f)
print(f'Old longest_edge: {cfg[\"size\"][\"longest_edge\"]}')
print(f'Old shortest_edge: {cfg[\"size\"][\"shortest_edge\"]}')
cfg['size']['longest_edge'] = 50176
cfg['size']['shortest_edge'] = 3136
with open('preprocessor_config.json', 'w') as f:
    json.dump(cfg, f, indent=2)
print('New longest_edge: 50176')
print('New shortest_edge: 3136')
"
```

## Step 5: Test with a Quick API Call
```
wget -q -O sample.jpg https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/3/3a/Cat03.jpg/1200px-Cat03.jpg
```

```
curl -s http://localhost:8000/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "/models/cosmos-reason2",
    "messages": [\
      {\
        "role": "user",\
        "content": [\
          {"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": "https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/3/3a/Cat03.jpg/1200px-Cat03.jpg"}},\
          {"type": "text", "text": "Describe what you see in this image."}\
        ]\
      }\
    ],
    "max_tokens": 256
  }' | python3 -m json.tool
```
